high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "factinfinity." The post features two photographs of a man with a mustache, each showing him with an insect on his face. In one photo, the insect is on his cheek, and in the other, it is on his nose. The text overlay on the image reads: **"@factinfinity DID YOU KNOW? The Schmidt pain index was created by a guy who intentionally subjected himself to the sting/bites of 78 different species of Hymenoptera (bees, wasps, ants, etc.) in order to quantify the intensity of pain experienced."
